description: Agreement executed for 2,000 SC-40 modules at $42 each ($84,000 total), delivery due February 15, FOB destination.
significance: Establishes original contract terms and deadline.

description: Horizon issues purchase order HM-1048 with February 15 delivery and standard anti-static packaging.
significance: Corroborates original specifications.

description: Summit acknowledges the order and plans February 13 dispatch.
significance: Confirms planned performance.

description: Summit internal report identifies shortages delaying batches B and C (1,400 modules).
significance: Production problems predate the labeling request, potentially weakening Summit’s causation defense.

description: Summit tells Horizon that February 15 delivery remains on schedule.
significance: Potential inconsistency between internal information and customer communications.

description: Horizon inquires about serial-range labels, conditioned on no delay or cost increase.
significance: Establishes the conditional labeling request.

description: Summit replies that serial-range labels are probably feasible; effect on timing is unconfirmed.
significance: No confirmed delivery extension.

description: Summit warns the full order will be late and cites chip shortage and labeling changes.
significance: Documents anticipated nonperformance and Summit’s competing explanations.

description: Westline Freight picks up an initial 600 modules; estimated arrival February 17.
significance: Shipment does not establish timely delivery.

description: Contractual delivery deadline passes without evidence of delivery to Horizon.
significance: Central alleged breach: delivery not completed by the contractual deadline.

description: Horizon memo warns of possible production interruption and lost customer order.
significance: Potential consequential losses not independently substantiated.

description: Horizon dock-scans 600 modules; receiving status initially on hold.
significance: Establishes delayed physical arrival.

description: Horizon finalizes receipt and accepts packaging of initial 600 modules.
significance: Partial delivery accepted.

description: Horizon accepts alternative quote for 1,000 modules at $59 each plus $1,250 expedited delivery.
significance: Potential $17,000 unit-price differential, subject to proof of cover and recoverability.

description: Front Range Controls invoices $60,250; February 23 delivery promised subject to stock.
significance: No proof of delivery or payment.

description: Horizon sends notice alleging material breach and reserving direct-damages remedies.
significance: Documents formal notice and stated position.

description: Promised date for alternative supplier delivery; fulfillment not established in the file.
significance: Mitigation documentation missing.

description: Summit disputes sole responsibility and asserts labeling changes shifted expectations.
significance: Principal causation and modification defense; no signed change order supplied.

description: Operations annotation records truck arrival of remaining 1,400 modules; receiving posted at 11:05.
significance: Late completion of physical delivery.

description: Forty modules from final shipment flagged for quality-control inspection.
significance: Final disposition unknown.

description: Summit invoices $84,000; March 5 AP hold pending reconciliation and QA review.
significance: Outstanding payment and possible offset issues.

description: Horizon AP extract shows no payment to Summit through March 6.
significance: Unpaid original invoice; no information on alternative supplier payment.
